Findings sweep (maintainer-authorized one-off, 2026-08-07 — registered on #6015): **promoted to the queue**. Five overrides declaring `options?: any` against a base that declares `DriverOptions` — the #5181 argument verbatim on the options axis: a misspelled `bypassTenantAudit` has no channel but `tsc`, and these five turn it off. Mechanical narrowing; batch with #6212/#6231/#6401. `finding` → `pm:queue`.

Measurement from #6394's implementation (that issue's cast sits on `TursoDriver.create`'s options gate, so I had to resolve which signature actually wins there). **The table in the body under-counts: it is 16 overrides, not 5.**

Filing this here rather than as a new issue because it is the same shape on the same axis — but it matters for scoping, since the body's own argument ("五个 override 的 `options?: any` 是逐字相同的一处形状，五改其一……会被下一个读者读成「对另外四个的判断」") applies with equal force to the eleven that are missing from the list.

## Full inventory

Baseline `origin/main` @ `64d764e`, `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts`:

```
grep -nE "override async [a-zA-Z]+\(.*options\?: any" packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts
```

| # | Method | Line | In the body's table? |
|--:|:--|--:|:--|
| 1 | `find` | 507 | ❌ |
| 2 | `findOne` | 512 | ❌ |
| 3 | `create` | 523 | ❌ |
| 4 | `update` | 528 | ✅ |
| 5 | `upsert` | 533 | ✅ |
| 6 | `delete` | 538 | ✅ |
| 7 | `count` | 543 | ✅ |
| 8 | `aggregate` | 558 | ✅ |
| 9 | `bulkCreate` | 960 | ❌ |
| 10 | `bulkUpdate` | 968 | ❌ |
| 11 | `bulkDelete` | 978 | ❌ |
| 12 | `updateMany` | 983 | ❌ |
| 13 | `deleteMany` | 990 | ❌ |
| 14 | `execute` | 999 | ❌ |
| 15 | `syncSchema` | 1027 | ❌ |
| 16 | `dropTable` | 1097 | ❌ |

I checked every one against its base: **all 16** have a `SqlDriver` base declaring `options?: DriverOptions` (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` — `find` 2789, `findOne` 2949, `create` 2961, `update` 3416, `upsert` 3444, `delete` 3480, `bulkCreate` 3503, `bulkUpdate` 3556, `bulkDelete` 3565, `updateMany` 3574, `deleteMany` 3586, `count` 3625, `execute` 3661, `aggregate` 3802, `syncSchema` 4082, `dropTable` 4090). So there is no subset here that is `any` for a legitimate reason — it is one uniform widening across the whole override surface.

## Why `create` in particular is worth calling out

#6394 removed a ` as never` on a `driver.create(…, { bypassTenantAudit: true })` options argument in `date-bucket-parity.test.ts`. I measured what removing it restores: **nothing**. With the cast gone, both a misspelled key and a wrong-typed value still compile clean, because override #3 above erases the parameter to `any`. Confirmed the test file really is in the compile graph (an unrelated `const x: number = "s"` in the same file does red with TS2322), so that is a real negative, not a skipped check.

The contrast against a driver that has *not* had this widening applied, same key, cast stripped:

```
src/sql-driver-runtime-token-default.test.ts(111,73): error TS2561: Object literal may only
specify known properties, but 'bypassTenantAuditt' does not exist in type '{ transaction?:
unknown; … bypassTenantAudit?: boolean | undefined; }'. Did you mean to write 'bypassTenantAudit'?
```

That is exactly the check this issue is about, working on `SqlDriver` and silent on `TursoDriver`.

## On the un-measured quantity the body asks for

The body notes it did not measure whether existing callers already pass `DriverOptions`-shaped values. I have not measured that across all 16 either, so that gate still stands before narrowing. One data point in its favour: `driver-turso`'s own 836-test suite and full package typecheck are green with the #6394 call site passing a plain `{ bypassTenantAudit: true }` — a declared key, correctly typed.

Also filed #6754 for the sibling shape: 27 dead `{ bypassTenantAudit: true } as any` casts in `driver-sql` / `driver-sqlite-wasm` tests. Those are the *inverse* trade to this issue — they sit on a real typed gate, so removing them buys checking immediately, whereas turso's casts are only worth touching after these 16 overrides are narrowed.
